definitions.explanation: Describes work, planning, or investigation carried out with great care and attention to every detail, leaving nothing overlooked.

examples.japanese: {綿密|めんみつ}な{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: We drew up a meticulous plan.

examples.japanese: {綿密|めんみつ}に{調査|ちょうさ}した{結果|けっか}、{原因|げんいん}が{判明|はんめい}した。
examples.english: As a result of thorough investigation, the cause was identified.

examples.japanese: この{報告書|ほうこくしょ}は{綿密|めんみつ}なデータ{分析|ぶんせき}に{基|もと}づいている。
examples.english: This report is based on detailed data analysis.

notes:
USAGE:
{綿密|めんみつ} is a な-adjective used primarily in formal or professional contexts. It modifies nouns directly ({綿密|めんみつ}な{計画|けいかく}) or is used adverbially with に ({綿密|めんみつ}に{調|しら}べる).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿密|めんみつ}な{計画|けいかく} (meticulous plan)
- {綿密|めんみつ}な{調査|ちょうさ} (thorough investigation)
- {綿密|めんみつ}に{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせる (to coordinate in detail)
- {綿密|めんみつ}な{分析|ぶんせき} (detailed analysis)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{丁寧|ていねい} means "careful" or "polite" and is broader in usage. {綿密|めんみつ} specifically emphasizes thoroughness and attention to fine detail, often in professional or academic work.
